sloka: गते रामे प्रशांत आत्मा रामो दाशरथिः धनुः ।वरुणाय अप्रमेयाय ददौ हस्ते महायशाः ॥१-७७-१॥
transliteration: gate rāme praśāṁta ātmā rāmo dāśarathiḥ dhanuḥ ।varuṇāya aprameyāya dadau haste mahāyaśāḥ ॥1-77-1॥

translations.english: When Parasurama departed, Rama, son of Dasaratha with a serene mind gave the bow along with the arrow to Varuna of immeasurable strength.
